title: a satisfies expression forwards the Result it checks rather than discarding it
notes: specification/failures.mdx:136: 'A Result MUST be treated as a must-use value. A source program MUST NOT silently discard a Result without returning, matching, transforming, inspecting, or unwrapping it.' specification/type-system.mdx:56: 'An ignored Result MUST be a compile error.' `satisfies` checks a value against a type and evaluates to that same value, so it is a forwarding position exactly like parentheses and `as`. It was simply missing from the reference's transparent-wrapper list, which made an ordinary annotated program unwritable.
